desc: Build adjacency list and compute degrees from the input tree.
For each vertex c as potential center: collect leaf counts degree(b)-1 for neighbors b with degree(b) >= 2.
Sort leaf counts in descending order.
For each index i, set y = leaf_counts[i], x = i+1, compute total = 1 + x + x*y, update global max.
Verify solution correctness with sample tests and edge cases (e.g., N=3 chain, star trees). Ensure time complexity O(N log N) is acceptable. Run final verification.
